notes: Native firmware 0.1.35 — the screensaver activation timeout: the panel had no idle return at all (the screensaver appeared only at boot/handshake; once the user left it, nothing brought it back). After N seconds without a touch the panel now navigates back (default 15 s, clamped 5..3600; the timeout rides the screensaver payload as activation_timeout; the last 0x65 page decides whether the panel is already asleep). Also: the P160 trap again — the idle poll's extern must live at file scope (an extern declared inside extern-C app_main gets C linkage and never links). Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
